text_block_list.text:
One day, I was brainstorming a new 
training plan. I had been racking my brain 
for quite some time, but――
――Excuse me, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You've been fretting over that for a while 
now…… Is that your training notebook?

The one calling out was Casino Drive. A 
capable Umamusume heading a project aiming 
for the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...I see, so you're out of ideas. In that 
case... shall we go outside?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
――All right, shall we begin? I will keep 
my kicks relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, as you kick, please name one 
training idea.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Feasibility is of no concern. Be it 
difficult or grand in scale. For 
instance――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Invite a past BC champion to be an 
exclusive coach. —Something like that.

The ball-passing suddenly began. But if 
wild ideas like that are fair game...
choice_data_list:
Then... let's run alongside a Triple Crown 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice! Keep up that momentum. Now 
then…… How about we do that tandem run 
every single day?
choice_data_list:
!? ……In that case, maybe some advice on 
form――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
All right, let us wrap it up around here. 
How was that, Trainer――

I quickly pull out my notebook to jot it 
down. Triple Crown Umamusume might be out 
of reach, but if it's a routine focused 
heavily on tandem running――

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Just as I thought. You've come up 
with a wonderful idea, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I haven't done anything special. Change 
the scenery, change your mindset. For 
rigid thinking, it works wonders.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
What matters is a flexible approach. As 
long as you adapt your methods and 
environment, and keep at it—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
A breakthrough is something we can 
definitely create.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
We must constantly explore and continue to 
experiment. Glory smiles upon those who 
exhaust every tactic.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
If you ever find yourself troubled again, 
do feel free to consult me. I shall lay 
out a plan toward success.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You can do this. Let's do our absolute 
best together.
